changes: First release of Position Controller
Added cross-platform launchers for Linux, macOS, and Windows
Added automatic Python runtime and dependency setup on first launch
Added a desktop interface
Added built-in release checking and secure update installation
Added searchable in-app help documentation
Added application restart and quit keyboard shortcuts
Added structured logging and temporary-file handling
Added the official application icon
Added automated GitHub release packaging and release-history support
First stable release
Added automatic serial-port discovery and monitoring
Added configuration for up to eight devices with independent serial ports and baud rates
Added asynchronous multi-device serial communication with connection-status indicators
Added G-code controls for relative and absolute movement, homing, origin setting, and configurable speed
Added application-wide keyboard movement controls for the X, Y, and Z axes
Added support for broadcasting custom messages to all connected devices
Added a resizable terminal with application logs and color-coded serial messages
Added buffered serial reads for partial and high-volume incoming data
Added contextual help and documentation for the new controls
Added a fake serial-port development helper for Linux and macOS
Added asynchronous update checking during application startup
Improved the application layout, startup sizing, icon, and theme detection
Improved update cleanup and Git-related guidance
Renamed platform launchers to place the operating-system name first
Updated launchers to require the uv-managed Python environment
